summary: Datannur is a lightweight data catalog designed for documenting and exploring structured data files and databases. It provides a centralised interface to help teams manage their data assets and schemas. The application is built using Python and distributed under the MIT licence.
goodFor: It suits small teams or individual developers who need a straightforward, self-hosted solution for catalogising databases and file-based data without heavy enterprise overhead.
watchOut: With a very small community and modest repository activity, you may encounter edge cases or lack support when integrating it into complex workflows.
deployNotes: As a Python application, it typically requires a WSGI or ASGI server, persistent storage for catalog metadata, and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
